visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a middle-aged male presenter with short grey hair and glasses, wearing a black polo shirt. He is framed in a medium shot against a night city skyline including the Taipei 101 building. A digital banner at the top advertises an AI Forum. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a spherical, metallic spacecraft component with the letters 'CCCP' visible, set against a dark, museum-like background. (3) The presenter returns to the screen, speaking directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. The lighting is bright and typical of a professional studio setup despite the city background. (4) A CGI animation shows a piece of space debris burning up in Earth's atmosphere, creating a fiery trail against the dark silhouette of the planet. (5) Back to the presenter in the same city-view setting, explaining the history of the Soviet probe. (6) Dark night dashcam footage is shown, capturing a bright blue streak (fireball) moving across the sky above a highway with various text overlays and data points. (7) The presenter reappears, intercutting with the probe image again while he continues his explanation. (8) In the final phase, the presenter points downward as colorful variety-style text and a 'Pansci News' logo appear to encourage audience interaction.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: AI Forum 2025. [Slogan]: 人工智慧論壇. [Logo]: 泛科學 News. [Subtitle]: 如果你在 5 月 10 號那天. (2) [Subtitle]: 看到天上有物體墜落. (3) [Subtitle]: 說不定你看到的是一艘 1970 年代的太空船. (4) [Subtitle]: 1972 年蘇聯在冷戰時期發射 Kosmos 482 探測器. (5) [Subtitle]: 原本目標是拜訪金星，不料運載火箭故障. (6) [Subtitle]: 探測器沒能逃出地球，引擎一關就變成太空垃圾. (7) [Subtitle]: 在近地軌道上滯留了半個多世紀. (8) [Subtitle]: 經過大氣阻力的年年磨耗. (9) [Subtitle]: 這塊太空古董終於在 2025 年 5 月 10 號重返地球. (10) [Subtitle]: 比蘇聯還慢解體，厲害. (11) [Subtitle]: 雖然最後墜落地點大約在印尼雅加達西方. (12) [Subtitle]: 約 350 公里的印度洋. (13) [Subtitle]: 但因為當初台灣也在掉落的範圍中. (14) [Subtitle]: 因此就有專家推測. (15) [Subtitle]: 5 月 9 號台灣東南部跟南部地區. (16) [Subtitle]: 深夜看到的那個藍色墜落物. (17) [Subtitle]: 除了可能是火流星外，或許也可能是 Kosmos 482 的其他碎片殘渣. (18) [Subtitle]: 哎呀，不過 53 年前它離開地球時. (19) [Subtitle]: 美國阿波羅計劃正結束. (20) [Subtitle]: 木村拓哉跟張惠妹才出生. (21) [Subtitle]: 幸好地球人還算爭氣. (22) [Subtitle]: 早在 Kosmos 482 回來之前，就把它調查得清清楚楚. (23) [Subtitle]: 不然天上突然掉下來這樣一顆. (24) [Subtitle]: 要說裡面沒有賽亞人，我是不相信. (25) [Slogan]: 想了解更多科學新聞嗎? 快點這裡. [Variety]: 許願下週《泛科NEWS》就來報!

A mid-tempo electronic BGM with a strong, synthesized four-on-the-floor beat starts immediately. (2) At 0:04, a subtle 'whoosh' sound effect emphasizes the visual transition to the space probe image. The speaker's pitch remains mid-range and professional. (3) Throughout the middle section, the vocal is continuous with excellent articulation. Short digital UI 'pips' or 'blips' are used as punctuation during date and location mentions. (4) During the meteor animation at 0:17, the BGM remains at a consistent level, and no environmental noise of the burning debris is added, keeping the focus on the narration. (5) In the final phase starting at 0:52, the speaker's tone becomes more playful and casual. A concluding 'sparkle' SFX sounds as the call-to-action text overlays appear, and the BGM ends with a clean fade-out.
